people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
translations.bsb: David constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
